items.title: Delegations Gather For US-Iran Summit Amid Fragile Regional Truce
items.description: Delegations from the United States, Iran, Qatar and Pakistan began gathering on June 21 at the Lake Lucerne Summit, launching what could become the most consequential diplomatic effort yet to stabilize the Middle East after weeks of war.
